reason: Audit (reports/paper/hllag_forward_audit.md): the container clock runs ~2.8 s behind real time and drifts ~-0.33 s/h. sim_lag compares our local Binance receive time with HL exchange timestamps, so forward entries were filled at HL quotes received 1.4-2.0 s BEFORE the signal (look-ahead in our favour). In the Tardis backtest HL quotes were received +130..340 ms after their exchange time.

scope: Applies retroactively to ALL forward trades since each freeze, including the 5 already scored under the old stamping (which were profitable under the flawed stamping and lose under this one). The old ledgers are kept as *_ledger_unamended.json for the record.
